senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; כפר to be round, [circle,] village, country town.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 1:3">Meg. I, 3</cite> <he>פחות מכאן הרי זה כ׳</he> if a place has less (than ten persons of leisure), it is considered a country place, opp. <he>עיר גדולה</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 1:1">Meg. I, 1</cite>, sq.; a. fr. [In compounds:… <cite ref="K01047"><he>כְּפַר</he></cite> pr. n. pl., v. respective determinants.]
